newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: ASEAN welcomes end to British rule in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN welcomes end to British rule in Hong Kong.

text.p: Nine Southeast Asian nations, most of them former European colonies, on Friday welcomed Britain's handover of Hong Kong to China as the end of colonialism in Asia.

A communiqu at the close of the two-day annual meeting of foreign ministers of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) "welcomed the return of Hong Kong to Chinese sovereignty, marking the end of centuries of colonialism in this part of the world".

"They expressed confidence that the substantial links between ASEAN member countries and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China would be maintained and continue to expand," the communiqu said.
Hong Kong reverted to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30 after more than 150 years as a British colony.

ASEAN members Malaysia, Singapore, Burma and Brunei are former British colonies, Laos and Vietnam are former colonies of France, Indonesia is a former Dutch colony and the Philippines a former colony of Spain and the United states.
